name: Kazami Rin
source:
A military officer of the Balbora Empire, part of a scouting party to Japan. Works as a spy. Because she isn't an enhanced human being, she has the rank of corporal. 

For the sake of finding Japan's "Stryker", her purpose is to gather intelligence on it, concealing herself as an ordinary person who is a student.
